common.tagline: Secure Peer-to-Peer Crypto Trading with Non-Custodial Escrow

home.heroSubtitle: Peer-to-peer lets you trade coins directly with other people. Our escrow and dispute moderation keep every trade protected.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Trading on Paxones is simple, secure, and fast. Follow these three easy steps to start your P2P journey.
home.step1Desc: Sign up for free with just a User ID. Complete a simple identity verification to secure your account and start trading.
home.step2Desc: Browse buy or sell ads from other users. Filter by coin, payment method, and amount to find the perfect match.
home.step3Desc: Initiate a trade and communicate with your partner via our secure chat. The seller's coin is locked in escrow for safety.
home.step4Desc: Once the buyer pays and the seller confirms, the coin is instantly released from escrow into the buyer's wallet.
home.whyP2PTitle: Why Trade on a P2P Platform?
home.whyP2PSubtitle: Peer-to-peer (P2P) trading offers unique advantages over traditional exchanges. Trade directly with other people, giving you more control over your price and payment methods.
home.directTradingDesc: Cut out the middleman. You negotiate and trade directly with another person, which can lead to better rates and faster transactions.
home.globalPaymentsDesc: Choose from hundreds of payment methods, including local bank transfers, online wallets, and more, making it easy to trade from anywhere.
home.controlDesc: Set your own prices, define your own terms, and choose who you trade with. P2P gives you the freedom traditional platforms can't.
home.securitySubtitle: We've engineered our platform with multi-layered security features to ensure every trade is protected from start to finish.
home.escrowDesc: When a trade starts, the seller's coin is automatically transferred into a secure, temporary holding vault (escrow). The funds are only released to the buyer once the seller has confirmed they've received the payment. This prevents sellers from running off with the payment without sending the coin, and protects buyers from fraudulent sellers.
home.disputeDesc: In the rare event of a disagreement, our dedicated support team is here to help. Either party can initiate a dispute. Our moderators will carefully review the trade details, chat logs, and payment evidence to make a fair and impartial decision, ensuring the coin is awarded to the rightful party.
home.supportedCoinsDesc: We support a growing list of popular digital assets, with more being added regularly.

marketplacePage.guideSubtitle: Follow our step-by-step guide to trade cryptocurrency with escrow protection.
marketplacePage.guideStep1Body: Create an account or sign in. Your account includes a wallet where you can securely store your crypto.
marketplacePage.guideStep2Body: Choose a payment method and currency, enter the amount you want, and browse matching offers.
marketplacePage.guideStep3Body: Read each offer's terms and review the trader's rate, reputation and feedback before proceeding.
marketplacePage.guideStep4Body: Choose an offer that meets your requirements, confirm the amount and start the trade to open its chat.
marketplacePage.guideStep5Body: Follow the seller's payment instructions and confirm only after you complete the transfer through your payment provider.
marketplacePage.guideStep6Body: After the payment is verified, the seller releases the crypto held in escrow to your wallet.
marketplacePage.faqSubtitle: Find answers to common questions from P2P traders.
marketplacePage.faqA1: Peer-to-peer trading lets users buy and sell cryptocurrency directly with each other without an intermediary institution.
marketplacePage.faqA2: You can trade Bitcoin (BTC), Tether (USDT), Ethereum (ETH) and Litecoin (LTC) using a wide range of local fiat payment methods.
marketplacePage.faqA3: Escrow protection holds the crypto during a trade and releases it according to the trade process after payment is verified.
marketplacePage.sellGuideSubtitle: Follow our step-by-step guide to sell your cryptocurrency safely using escrow protection.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep1Body: Log in to your account and make sure your wallet is funded with crypto to sell.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep2Body: Select your desired payout method (Bank Transfer, Mobile Money, Cash) and currency to find matching buyer offers.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep3Body: Review the buyer's positive feedback score, completed trade count, and identity verification badge.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep4Body: Start the trade. Your crypto is safely locked in escrow and cannot be claimed until you confirm receipt of payment.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep5Body: Verify the funds directly in your bank account, mobile money app, or wallet before releasing the crypto.
marketplacePage.sellGuideStep6Body: Once payment is received in full, select Release Crypto to deliver the coins to the buyer and leave feedback.
marketplacePage.sellFaqSubtitle: Answers to common questions from P2P sellers.
marketplacePage.sellFaqQ1: How do I get paid when selling crypto?
marketplacePage.sellFaqA1: The buyer sends funds directly to your chosen payment account (bank account, PayPal, Wise, mobile money, etc.) based on your trade terms.
marketplacePage.sellFaqQ2: When should I release the crypto from escrow?
marketplacePage.sellFaqA2: Release crypto only after checking your bank or payment account and confirming that the exact fiat payment has settled. Never rely on payment screenshots alone.
marketplacePage.sellFaqQ3: What happens if the buyer marks as paid but hasn't sent funds?
marketplacePage.sellFaqA3: Do not release the escrow. You can open a dispute when the timer allows, and the moderation team can review the evidence and resolve the trade.
